cases.name: Nichole Marie Doerschler
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Nichole graduated from Comstock High School in 2002 and has since dedicated nearly twenty years to her career at Stryker. She loved going to concerts, crafting with her friends, and could always find a good sale. Nichole was strong-willed, always happy, and enjoyed the thrill of finding her next adventure. She enjoyed volunteering at The American Legion in Climax and was always there to help anyone in need without hesitation. Nichole loved her dogs, hiking in the mountains, and looked forward to one day traveling to Ireland. She was always excited to throw a holiday party, especially for her favorite holiday, Halloween. But most importantly, Nichole had an infinite love for her two children. She was always there to support them with her boundless energy and enthusiasm. She was the snack mom, the cool mom, the over-the-top cheer mom at ball games, and her passion for life was for them."
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot her in the head.
